invariants.name: increasing_subtree_sequence
invariants.description: For each vertex v, a recursive construction builds a strictly increasing sequence of all vertices in its subtree, and inserts v at position c_v so that exactly c_v predecessors satisfy a_j < a_v.

invariants.name: c_v_within_subtree_size
invariants.description: For any valid assignment, c_i must not exceed the size of subtree i minus 1, enforced by the check during construction.
